newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin says exercised half its budget.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin says exercised half its budget.

text.p: Mexico's development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin) has so far only exercised half its programmed budget for 1996, though it is not the institution's fault, director general Gilberto Borja Navarrete said Friday.
"About 50 percent of the budget has gone, but it is not a problem of Nacional Financiera's," Borja told reporters.
"Many small and medium sized companies have no market and there are other projects that we have to see if they are viable."
Nafin's budget, aimed at providing loans to foster businesses, is 55 billion pesos for this year.
